messages:
ryea: Heads-up: planning a staged unpin of runtime 2.15 -> 2.18 on hosted canary at 02:00 UTC to pick up kernel batching fixes. Change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Perf lab showed a.k.a. tail regression for longseq with quant models in eu-north. Telemetry: https://internal/telemetry/3987-quant-longtail
carter: +1. Need explicit rollback gates and a backstop to pin SDK or route model-tagged traffic if needed. Who's owning the rollout ops? @ops-sre?
ops-sre: I'll own watch/rollback. Rollback triggers: if canary.cust_error_rate > 0.007 OR p99_latency >= baseline * 1.35 sustained 7m -> pin runtime=2.15 cohort=canary and page. Also if top-5 trace tail samples show token-timeouts.
emily: Recommend staged ramp: 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Keep model-tag=quant-long pinned to 2.15 as a fallback route. Also set feature flag `unpin.398765` and header `X-RW-COHORT: unpin-3987`.
nathan: SDK impact: SDK 3.3 clients with early-kv warm hints might see miss ratio shifts. We'll add opt-in header `X-RW-SDK-Compat: legacy-warm` and document it. I'll prepare a changelog blurb.yea: Plan: 02:00 start -> 3% 15m smoke -> 15% 25m -> 60% 30m -> 100% if green. QA path at /qa/3987/longseq. Release notes draft: https://notes.internal/rel-3987654321
carter: Ops checklist: enable `trace.kvcache_canary`, set metrics `canary.unpin.p99_delta`, increase trace retention to 3h for the window. Add verbose kvcache logs for cohort.
deploybot: schedule created by @ryea. job id deploy-3987654321-01. To cancel: `/deploy cancel deploy-3987654321-01`. Automated rollback policy attached.
ops-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
# quick rollback
if (canary.cust_error_rate > 0.007) or (p99_now >= p99_baseline*1.35 for 7m):
  deploybot pin runtime=2.15 cohort=canary
  post "UNPIN ROLLBACK" to #incidents with p99 graphs + top traces
  page eng-runtime oncall
  collect top-50 kvcache traces and enable debug for 30m
  if >5 impacted tenants: prepare a customer status update draft
```
emily: QA will run longseq quant-v3 on llama2-13b and a burst test for warm misses. I'll post results after the 15% step. Test harness: /qa/3987/longseq and /qa/3987/burst
nathan: I've got a small SDK shim ready to auto-inject the compat header for legacy tenant tags if rollback occurs. Will not release pre-window.
ryea: Tagging @support and @product for comms pre- and post-change. We'll have a short status blurb ready if rollback happens.
carter: Also add routing rule: divert traffic with header `X-RW-SDK-Compat: legacy-warm` to pinned runtime by default during window. Ops note: verify routing limits to avoid capacity exhaust.
ops-sre: I'll validate routing throttles and capacity as preflight. Will post a preflight checklist 30m before window.
deploybot: automated update: step1 (3%) scheduled at 3987656100, job deploy-3987654321-01 queued.
